meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查询 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库:先搜出带 ID 的结果列表,再看时间线上下文,最后只取相关条目的完整细节;只有摘要不够用时才调取原始工具输入输出。
howto.when: 当你问的是以前的会话、而非当前对话时触发,比如“这个我们之前解决过吗?”“上次 X 是怎么做的?”等。

say.text: 上次那个登录 bug 我们是怎么解决的?
say.note: 先返回带 ID 的搜索结果表

say.text: 搜一下上周跟数据库迁移有关的记录
say.note: 按日期范围搜索观察记录

say.text: 把 #11131 这条的完整细节取出来
say.note: 读取该条观察的完整内容

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can query claude-mem's cross-session memory: it searches for an index with IDs, checks timeline context nearby, then fetches full details only for the relevant hits, and reads raw tool input/output only when summaries are not enough.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about PREVIOUS sessions rather than the current conversation, e.g. "did we already fix this?" or "how did we solve X last time?".

say_en.text: How did we fix that login bug last time?
say_en.note: Returns a search table with IDs first

say_en.text: Search last week's notes about the DB migration
Pull the full details of observation #11131
